Subjective holistic assessment of observed emulated portrait play, not a win/loss grade or physical-device certification. Overall is a judgment, not an arithmetic mean.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent, attractive short mission with actionable touch assistance and clear progress. Portrait clutter, small scene labels and limited uninterrupted manual sampling temper confidence. Both wins are outcomes, not the reason for the grade.
reasons.controls: Two-contact MOVE plus FIRE drag and scene turns worked in both attempts. Target taps and down feedback helpful. Continuous holding, rearming and physical-thumb comfort remain unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, patrol, coil and deck phases gave distinct observed tasks and feedback. Assisted traversal dominated; only brief manual fights, so depth, sustained challenge and long-session enjoyment cannot be graded confidently.
reasons.presentation: Consistent teal/amber sci-fi identity, rain, reflective floor, distinct weapon and terminal presentation. Some dark geometry and small in-world text reduce legibility. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Context-sensitive hold action, persistent objective/recovery checks, planning map route, and explicit terminal assist breakdown are helpful. Route and threat warnings compete in a narrow portrait layout.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo/objective and terminal stats readable; in-world signs, small coil numerals and secondary warnings require close inspection. Lower controls occupy considerable scene space.
